name: manual_b8793c
claim: Probe inference discovery and control-plane delivery independently: an empty model-discovery result does not prove a verified HTTPS portal is offline, and a reachable portal does not prove that inference is available or that a file was received.

decisions.notes: The recovery record contains both a model endpoint discovery miss and later accepted portal deliveries. Separate current probes and exact receiver receipts prevent stale discovery from blocking a working channel or a health response from becoming a completion claim.

rationale: The recovery record contains both a model endpoint discovery miss and later accepted portal deliveries. Separate current probes and exact receiver receipts prevent stale discovery from blocking a working channel or a health response from becoming a completion claim.
